name: Traefik
description: Cloud-native HTTP reverse proxy and load balancer.
summary: Traefik welcomes AI-assisted contributions when substantial AI help is declared with an Assisted-by trailer and larger code generation is discussed with a maintainer first. It requires issue and PR conversations to remain human, AI-drafted messages to be rewritten in the contributor's own voice, and AI-generated security reports to be validated and disclose AI use.

evidence.quote: **Declare substantial AI assistance** with an `Assisted-by:` trailer at the bottom of the commit message whenever an agent produced a meaningful portion of the diff — for example `Assisted-by: Claude Opus 4.6`.
**Align with a maintainer before generating code for anything larger than a bug fix.**
Do not let an agent post comments, review replies, or triage messages on your behalf.
disclose your use of AI tooling

Unvalidated
AI-generated reports are closed immediately.
**Keep issue and PR conversations human.** Do not let an agent post comments, review replies, or triage messages on your behalf.
If an agent drafted a message for you, rewrite it in your own voice before sending — maintainers need to know they are talking to a person, not a bot.

sources.title: Traefik — Contributor Guide for AI Agents
